examples.text_en: He was upfront about the money problems.
examples.text_zh: 他对钱的问题很坦率。

examples.text_en: They had to pay the money upfront.
examples.text_zh: 他们不得不预先付钱。

examples.text_en: The company will upgrade the old system.
examples.text_zh: 公司将升级这套旧系统。

examples.text_en: He got an upgrade to a big room.
examples.text_zh: 他升级到了一间大房间。

examples.text_en: The country faced a great upheaval that year.
examples.text_zh: 那一年这个国家面临巨大的剧变。

examples.text_en: The war brought upheaval to the whole town.
examples.text_zh: 战争给整个小镇带来了剧变。

examples.text_en: The law must uphold the rights of all.
examples.text_zh: 法律必须维护所有人的权利。

examples.text_en: They will uphold the old rules of the town.
examples.text_zh: 他们将维护镇上的旧规矩。

examples.text_en: The upkeep of the old house was very high.
examples.text_zh: 这座老房子的维护费用很高。

examples.text_en: He could not pay the upkeep of the car.
examples.text_zh: 他付不起这辆车的保养费。

examples.text_en: They walked across the high upland.
examples.text_zh: 他们走过高高的高地。

examples.text_en: The upland was wide and open to the air.
examples.text_zh: 这片高地开阔而通风。

examples.text_en: He was an upright and honest man.
examples.text_zh: 他是个正直诚实的人。

examples.text_en: The old box stood upright on the ground.
examples.text_zh: 旧箱子笔直地立在地上。

examples.text_en: The uprising began in the small town.
examples.text_zh: 起义在这个小镇爆发。

examples.text_en: They led the uprising against the king.
examples.text_zh: 他们领导了反对国王的起义。

examples.text_en: There was a great uproar in the meeting.
examples.text_zh: 会议上出现了一阵大骚动。

examples.text_en: His words caused an uproar among the people.
examples.text_zh: 他的话在人群中引起了一片喧哗。
